Sarah (CS): @Alex welcome! quick check — Montara TeleMed asked for APAC onboarding allowlist + temporary throughput bump while they run a pilot. They also mentioned billing flagged a potential renewal risk if latency issues appear.
Alex (Montara): Hi all :wave: yup — pilot starts Tue UTC. IPs attached below. Need TLS SNI pinning on our proxy as well. We want the burst window limited and auto-revoked.
Ryan (Eng Infra): can you paste the IPs/ports and exact qps request? we'll decide CIDR vs per-IP allowlist.
Alex (Montara): IPs:
```
203.0.113.45
203.0.113.46
203.0.113.47
```
Ports: 443, 8443
Requested bump: +250 qps for 72h (auto-revoke)
Sarah (CS): tagging @Josh for header pin + APAC proxy route. @Maria FYI on billing so we can preempt renewal churn.
Josh (NetOps): can do SNI pinning and add the IPs to APAC edge allowlist. Plan:
- add IPs to edge ACL
- create transient rate-window + auto-revoke cron
- apply SNI pin rule to proxy config
I can schedule at 10:30 UTC tomorrow.
Maria (AE): I'll reach out to their billing contact to explain expected pilot spike and offer a small credit to mitigate renewal risk. Alex - can you share expected tokens/day?
Alex (Montara): estimate ~1.2M tokens/day for the 72h pilot. Billing contact: rachel@montaramed.com
Sarah (CS): noted. Requesting window start 2024-05-14T10:30:00Z, duration 72h, auto-revoke=true. Work items: @Josh implement, @Ryan add monitoring and alerts, onboard-bot to post status updates.
onboard-bot: config-change request received: allowlist add + temporary rate-window (id: tmp-amt-723)
Ryan (Eng Infra): added monitoring hooks to /ops/telemetry for this client; will alert on p95 > 350ms and error-rate > 0.5%.
Josh (NetOps): done — edge ACL updated, SNI pin rule applied, rate window scheduled. config id tmp-amt-723.
onboard-bot: change applied to APAC edge. scheduled revoke: 2024-05-17T10:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
Maria (AE): I'm calling Rachel now to confirm the credit and confirm the token estimate. I'll log the conversation and renewal flag in SFDC.
Sarah (CS): thanks team — Alex, DM me if you see client-side errors during the pilot and we'll extend the window if needed. :thumbsup:
